_about: A benchmark against similar products. Products are fictional. The method is written down first: who is in the group, which tasks, how it was measured, and what the comparison cannot control.

method.peer_group: 20 consumer shopping apps with a chat assistant, available in Poland and Germany, at least 100k installs; chosen on 2026-10-05 before any measurement
tasks: ask for a refund on a delivered order
make a small change to an order via the agent
method.measurement: same phone model, same Wi-Fi throttled to a 4G profile, median of 5 runs, 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16
not_controlled: server load and traffic at the time of the run
A/B tests the peers may be running
legal requirements that differ by country
app versions changing during the week

refund_resolution.label: refund cases resolved by the assistant
refund_resolution.peer_note: measured for the 10 peers that let a test account file refunds

tool_calls.label: tool calls for a small order change
tool_calls.peer_note: measured for the 5 peers whose assistant can change orders

clear_error_message.label: a clear message when the card has expired

visible_support_contact.label: a visible way to reach a person

order_history_in_chat.label: order history available inside the chat

dictionary_app._about: The post's example: a dictionary app that loads the whole dictionary instead of single entries.
dictionary_app.metric: time to first lookup on a cold start (s)
dictionary_app.cause: on start, our app downloads and parses the whole 38 MB dictionary; the peers fetch one entry (~4 KB) per lookup

requirements._about: 'Competitors do it' is one source of evidence. Keep it apart from 'users need it' and 'the law requires it'.

clear_error_message.users: 3rd most common complaint in support tickets (Q3)

visible_support_contact.users: usability study: 6 of 8 could not find help
visible_support_contact.law: consumer law requires a way to contact the trader (check per market)

pre_ticked_marketing_consent.law: under the GDPR a pre-ticked box is not valid consent (CJEU, Planet49, 2019)
